groupCoverageReview.finding: A mixed run can have two AVC jobs in one exact source group and only one raw job in another. Adding their comparison counts would conceal the raw group's zero cross-file/chat comparisons even though no ranges are directly compared across groups.
groupCoverageReview.change: Report bounded ordinal group labels, format and each exact group's within-job, cross-job and approximate-chat dimensions. Register each successfully inspected group even when exclusions make cross-file comparison ineligible. All observed groups must individually have verified dimensions, and evidence must be valid, before fullContinuityVerified can be true. Aggregate dimensions remain summaries, not substitutes for per-group evidence. recordingFlowVerified remains independent; no source IDs or new parser/production changes.
groupCoverageReview.regression: A verified AVC group plus a raw singleton remains fullContinuityVerified=false; zero raw comparisons retain not_verified/null. Two independently verified groups may pass, but a failed dimension never does.
